title: CLARIFY: Contrastive Preference Reinforcement Learning for Untangling Ambiguous Queries
summary: Invalid core convex-separation derivation and a local rejection-sampling discrepancy; empirical results remain untested.

problems.claim: Proposition 5.2/Appendix A.2 convex separation at global loss minimum
problems.check: Independent Uniform[0,2] and Uniform[-1,1] draws make all four Eq29 expectations identical for every encoder; global loss 0. Means1,0 yield eta1/2; signed distances at positive0 and negative1 are -1/2,+1/2. Convexity cannot extend centroid bounds.
problems.result: Appendix statement false as printed; derivation for main objective invalid, with Eq6 interpretation explicitly separated.
problems.counterevidence: Eq29 differs from Eq6; empirical plots and release objective do not establish a universal theorem.
problems.impact: Invalid core theoretical derivation; empirical scores not refuted.
problems.correction: Conditional radius-margin statement proved; no complete original-theorem repair.

independent_verification.original_claim_and_location: Read original PDF physical p12 Proposition A.2/Eqs28-35, p6 Proposition5.2 and p4 Eq6; visually inspected p12 to rule out text-extraction changes to Eq29.
independent_verification.operative_assumptions: Convex supports and finite means; independent positive/negative draws can arise from disjoint trajectory domains with deterministic preference ordering. The theorem supplies no separating-support or class-radius premise. Nonzero mean difference holds in the example.
independent_verification.decisive_check: Independence makes every cross-label expectation in printed Eq29 equal, including the within-query terms; thus the functional is identically zero over finite-expectation encoders for that fixed product-pair distribution. Uniform supports [0,2] and [-1,1] are convex, means 1 and 0 give signed distance z-1/2; positive z<1 and negative z>0 violate the asserted bounds on sets of positive measure. Independently, an affine functional at a mean cannot be a pointwise bound on a convex support.
independent_verification.alternatives_and_counterevidence: Eq6 has within-class negative terms and does not share the cancellation. The report correctly confines the global-minimum counterexample to printed Eq29 and retains only an invalid-proof conclusion for the main objective. Undefined minimization with a margin cannot furnish the missing pointwise geometric premise without further assumptions.
independent_verification.core_dependency_and_severity: Confirmed Major: p6 explicitly uses Proposition5.2 for linear separation and safe query filtering. Benchmark results and actual encoder behavior are not refuted.
independent_verification.repair_scope: Radius bound follows by Cauchy-Schwarz from signed-distance change; r_plus,r_minus<eta yields a positive margin. It is conditional geometry, not evidence that the training loss enforces those radii.

problems.claim: Released rejection routine targets the requested histogram
assumptions: Positive discrete proposal and normalized target
problems.counterevidence: May be intentional heuristic filtering; downstream selection changes distribution; historical run provenance unknown.
problems.impact: Release-local sampling discrepancy; no measured benchmark damage.
problems.correction: Use envelope M>=max q/p to recover target before downstream selection.

independent_verification.original_claim_and_location: Read original p4 section4.2 and static reward_model.py reject_sampling lines62-69 plus contrastive_sampling lines602-647.
independent_verification.operative_assumptions: Positive discrete proposal and normalized target; idealized bin centers; acceptance clipping. No historical-run identity assumed.
independent_verification.decisive_check: Independent normalization: p*min(q/p,1)=(1/2,1/10), total3/5, hence output(5/6,1/6). The 1e-6 denominator perturbs this, but does not introduce a dominating envelope. The existing exact-output values agree with this new arithmetic check.
independent_verification.alternatives_and_counterevidence: Heuristic filtering is defensible, and subsequent disagreement sorting intentionally alters the law; neither establishes exact target sampling at the preceding rejection stage.
independent_verification.core_dependency_and_severity: Minor release-local discrepancy is proportionate because neither historical provenance nor benchmark effect is established.
independent_verification.repair_scope: With common support and M>=max(q/p), p*q/(Mp)=q/M and normalization recovers q. This says nothing about density estimation or the full downstream pipeline.
